title: DGI Presentation 2025
doc_notes: This document is an unclassified AARO presentation from February 2025 regarding UAP analytic trends, methodology, and specific case studies like the Mt. Etna object and Starlink flaring.

incidents.summary: A US UAS platform captured video of an unidentified object while observing an eruption of Mt. Etna.
incidents.explanation: Assessed as a balloon drifting with the wind approximately 170 kilometers from the volcano.
incidents.quote: the object appeared to pass through the volcano's plume without any impact on its performance, altitude, or trajectory.

incidents.summary: Controlled experiments using telemetered airborne surrogate targets to validate GEOINT methods.
incidents.quote: Surrogate targets exhibited similar behaviors and morphologies as widely reported UAP behaviors
